## What's fixed
- Saving a copy of an MDLZ with an external conflict now creates a complete MDLZ package, preserving pending form answers and local images. - The recovered copy opens only after verification. The externally changed original remains intact, and failed recovery keeps the pending draft available. - Package recovery rejects text-only destinations and locations inside temporary package storage.
## Beta limitations
- This release supports Apple silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. - The document toolbar may wrap in narrow layouts; this remains tracked in issue #302. - Hosted update, installation and relaunch acceptance for this new candidate remains pending.

## What's new
- Open an illustrated offline user guide from Help or Welcome, in English or Spanish, with practice fields and agent setup instructions. - Open project files in another tab from the context menu or with a double-click while retaining the project sidebar. - Simplify navigation around projects and documents by removing workspace grouping. Existing legacy preference data is preserved. - Fix synchronization suspension checks so blocked path operations are rejected before acquiring instance ownership.
## Beta limitations
- This release supports Apple silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. - Hosted update, installation and relaunch acceptance for this candidate remains pending. - The user guide toolbar may wrap in narrow layouts; this remains tracked in issue #302.

## What's new
- Choose a theme for each favorite project or workspace from the Favorites list. - Favorite items opened from Recents use the same theme association. - Themes apply to the relevant session without changing global appearance or shared project settings. Choose Inherit to restore the existing appearance settings. - A workspace theme takes precedence for its projects. Switching to an unrelated project restores that project's appearance.
- Browse favorites by category with horizontal tabs and scroll lists that show up to five items at once.
## Beta notes
This is a beta release for Apple silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. Select the beta update channel in Preferences to receive beta updates.
Hosted update, installation and relaunch testing for this beta remains pending.

# Leonardo document associations
- Default-application setup now covers `.md`, `.markdown`, `.mdlf`, `.mdlr` and `.mdlz`. - MDLZ packages now declare a physical ZIP-based document type so Finder can recognize them. - Startup consent, General preferences and the user guide now describe the complete format scope in English and Spanish.
After updating, review **Preferences → General → Default document application** and choose **Use LeonardoMD** if needed to apply the associations. macOS may ask for confirmation. Individual Finder “Open With” overrides may remain in effect.
This beta is for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. Text-file (`.txt`) associations are unchanged.

## Updates
- Additional app instances now receive normal Quit requests before an update downloads. Unsaved documents and active Git operations retain their usual close checks. - An update stops if an instance refuses to close or remains open. New instances are blocked while the installer is pending. - The update flow dismisses its Preferences sheet while preserving unrelated dialogs and pending decisions. - Automatic update checks remain available; downloads require your approval.
## Known limitations
- Updating from an older version still uses that version's close behavior. If it remains open, finish any save or Git operation, close Preferences, and quit normally. - Instances that have already closed remain closed if another instance cancels. - Install and relaunch testing of this beta is pending.
